exposure: Maternal age (<40 years vs. ≥40 years) within the singleton pregnancy group
outcome: Admission to the intensive care unit
cohort: 225 singleton pregnancies and 113 multiple pregnancies resulting in 447 live births
finding: Multiple pregnancies from oocyte donation cycles had a higher incidence of obstetric and perinatal complications compared to singleton pregnancies.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were higher in the singleton pregnancy group aged ≥40 years compared to those <40 years.
